chcv_readonly_banner: A conversation from %1$s — read-only; replies are made in %2$s
chcv_unreachable: Couldn't read the channel conversations from Hermes just now; showing what was last read.
chcv_has_more: Only the latest 500 messages of this conversation are shown.
chcv_no_messages: No text messages in this conversation yet.
chcv_continue_title: Continue this conversation in Core Hub
chcv_continue_hint: A new chat in this profile starts with this conversation attached for the agent to read. The conversation on %1$s stays as it is.
chcv_continue_note: What should the agent do with it? (optional)
chcv_continue_no_agent: No agent in this profile can take it. Install one from Agents first.
chcv_delete_body: The conversation and its messages are removed from Hermes for everyone, permanently. This cannot be undone. The chat in %1$s itself is not affected.
chcv_picture_gone: A picture was sent here. Hermes keeps channel pictures for a day, and this one is gone.
cat_new_in_profile: It is made in the profile %1$s, and everyone who can enter that profile sees it.
cat_confirm_delete_body: Its chats stay: they go back to the list without a category.
cat_empty_group: Long-press a chat and choose “Move to category” to file it here.
